## Introduction

BoneMarrowMap labeled every cell in the 26 AML libraries and the 2 healthy controls of
SCPCP000007 (`09_predict-scpca-bonemarrowmap.R`). There's no truth, so this notebook checks the
labels against evidence BoneMarrowMap didn't use:

- **Protein (ADT, 21 targets)**, the main independent check, especially of HSPC *state*
  (CD90, CD49f, CD45RA, CD133).
- **RNA marker genes** for each label.
- **ScPCA's consensus labels.**
- **The healthy controls**, which should look like normal marrow.

It starts with a specific concern from the mapping run. In the KMT2A-rearranged library
(SCPCL000343), 76% of cells were labeled orthochromatic erythroblast with high mapping error,
while ScPCA's consensus found no erythroid cells there. **Do off-reference or low-complexity
cells default to late erythroblast labels?**

See `.workspace/annotate-aml/scpcp000007.md` (step 3) for the plan.

Conventions:

- **Mapping QC uses one threshold across the project** (2.5 MADs above the median of all cells;
  decision 3 in `bonemarrowmap.md`), not BoneMarrowMap's per-library flag.
- **Pseudotime is set to NA for T, NK, plasma and stromal labels**, which sit outside the
  reference's hierarchy (as in 06).
- **ADT "positive"** means above the 95th percentile of the same target in a population that
  shouldn't express it, taken from the healthy controls (see "ADT positivity thresholds"). It's a
  heuristic for summarizing, not a gate.

## Setup

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

root_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_dir(".git"))
module_dir <- fs::path(root_dir, "analyses", "annotate-aml")
scpca_results <- fs::path(module_dir, "results", "scpca")
bmm_file <- fs::path(scpca_results, "bonemarrowmap", "bonemarrowmap_predictions_SCPCP000007.tsv")
features_file <- fs::path(scpca_results, "features", "cell_features_SCPCP000007.tsv")
metadata_file <- fs::path(root_dir, "data", "scpca", "SCPCP000007", "single_cell_metadata.tsv")

stopifnot(fs::file_exists(bmm_file), fs::file_exists(features_file), fs::file_exists(metadata_file))

# Plot style and plot_crosstab() shared with the evaluation reports
source(fs::path(module_dir, "utils", "eval-helpers.R"))
theme_set(eval_theme())

mad_threshold <- 2.5
# Labels outside the reference's pseudotime hierarchy (see 06)
off_hierarchy_broad <- c("Naive T", "CD4 Memory T", "CD8 Memory T", "NK", "Plasma Cell", "Stromal")
```

## Load

```{r load}
bmm <- data.table::fread(bmm_file, data.table = FALSE)
features <- data.table::fread(features_file, data.table = FALSE)
stopifnot(setequal(bmm$cell_id, features$cell_id))

sample_metadata <- data.table::fread(metadata_file, data.table = FALSE) |>
  transmute(library_id = scpca_library_id, subdiagnosis, disease_timing)

cells <- bmm |>
  inner_join(features |> select(-library_id, -sample_id, -barcode), by = "cell_id") |>
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = "library_id") |>
  mutate(
    role = factor(role, levels = c("healthy control", "AML")),
    off_hierarchy = bmm_label_broad %in% off_hierarchy_broad,
    bmm_pseudotime = if_else(off_hierarchy, NA_real_, bmm_pseudotime),
    singlet = scDblFinder_class == "singlet"
  )

# Project-wide mapping QC
qc_threshold <- median(cells$bmm_mapping_error) + mad_threshold * mad(cells$bmm_mapping_error)
cells <- cells |> mutate(qc_pass = bmm_mapping_error < qc_threshold)

stopifnot(nrow(cells) == nrow(bmm))
qc_threshold
count(cells, role, qc_pass) |> knitr::kable()
count(cells, role, singlet) |> knitr::kable()

adt_targets <- sub("^adt_", "", grep("^adt_", colnames(cells), value = TRUE))
adt_targets <- setdiff(adt_targets, "scpca_filter")
rna_genes <- sub("^rna_", "", grep("^rna_", colnames(cells), value = TRUE))
adt_targets
```

Label order used throughout: hierarchy labels by median pseudotime across all cells, then
off-hierarchy labels in a fixed order (T, NK, plasma, stromal).

```{r label-order}
order_labels <- function(cells, label_col) {
  in_hierarchy <- cells |>
    filter(!off_hierarchy) |>
    group_by(label = .data[[label_col]]) |>
    summarize(median_pt = median(bmm_pseudotime)) |>
    arrange(median_pt, label) |>
    pull(label)
  off <- cells |>
    filter(off_hierarchy) |>
    mutate(group = match(bmm_label_broad, off_hierarchy_broad)) |>
    distinct(label = .data[[label_col]], group) |>
    arrange(group, label) |>
    pull(label)
  c(in_hierarchy, off)
}
fine_levels <- order_labels(cells, "bmm_label")
broad_levels <- order_labels(cells, "bmm_label_broad")
```

## ADT positivity thresholds

For each target, a population that shouldn't express it, from the healthy controls (cells
passing QC, singlets). "Positive" means above that population's 95th percentile.

- T cell targets (CD3, CD7, CD25, CD127, CD152, CD279) and CD45RA: CD14 monocytes.
- CD45: late erythroid cells (erythroblasts are CD45-negative).
- Everything else: T cells.

```{r adt-thresholds}
healthy <- cells |> filter(role == "healthy control", qc_pass, singlet)

negative_population <- function(target) {
  if (target %in% c("CD3", "CD7", "CD25", "CD127", "CD152", "CD279", "CD45RA")) {
    healthy |> filter(bmm_label == "CD14 Mono")
  } else if (target == "CD45") {
    healthy |> filter(bmm_label_broad == "Late Erythroid")
  } else {
    healthy |> filter(bmm_label_broad %in% c("Naive T", "CD4 Memory T", "CD8 Memory T"))
  }
}

adt_thresholds <- purrr::map(adt_targets, \(target) {
  neg <- negative_population(target)
  tibble::tibble(
    target = target,
    n_negative_cells = nrow(neg),
    threshold = quantile(neg[[paste0("adt_", target)]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()

knitr::kable(adt_thresholds, digits = 2)

# Logical "positive" columns, pos_<target>
for (target in adt_targets) {
  thr <- adt_thresholds$threshold[adt_thresholds$target == target]
  cells[[paste0("pos_", target)]] <- cells[[paste0("adt_", target)]] > thr
}
```

## Are late erythroid labels real?

For cells BoneMarrowMap calls erythroid, check erythroid protein (CD235ab, glycophorin A/B;
CD71, transferrin receptor), hemoglobin RNA, genes detected per cell, mapping error, and ScPCA's
consensus label. Real late erythroblasts should be CD235ab+ with abundant hemoglobin.

```{r erythroid-by-library}
erythroid_summary <- cells |>
  filter(bmm_label_broad %in% c("Early Erythroid", "Late Erythroid")) |>
  group_by(role, library_id, subdiagnosis, bmm_label_broad) |>
  summarize(
    n_cells = n(),
    frac_CD235ab_pos = mean(pos_CD235ab, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_CD71_pos = mean(pos_CD71, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_HBB_detected = mean(rna_HBB > 0),
    median_genes_detected = median(detected),
    median_mapping_error = median(bmm_mapping_error),
    frac_qc_fail = mean(!qc_pass),
    frac_consensus_erythroid = mean(grepl("erythr", consensus_celltype_annotation)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(bmm_label_broad, frac_CD235ab_pos)

erythroid_summary |> knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

```{r erythroid-plot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
erythroid_summary |>
  filter(n_cells >= 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = median_genes_detected, y = frac_CD235ab_pos, size = n_cells, color = role)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~bmm_label_broad) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`healthy control` = ink_secondary, AML = "#1baf7a"), name = NULL) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 6, name = "Cells") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Median genes detected per cell", y = "Fraction CD235ab+",
       title = "Erythroid-labeled cells by library",
       subtitle = "Libraries with at least 20 cells in the label")
```

Within late erythroid calls, how do CD235ab-negative cells compare with CD235ab-positive ones?

```{r erythroid-pos-vs-neg}
cells |>
  filter(bmm_label_broad == "Late Erythroid") |>
  group_by(role, CD235ab = if_else(pos_CD235ab, "CD235ab+", "CD235ab-")) |>
  summarize(
    n_cells = n(),
    median_genes_detected = median(detected),
    median_umis = median(sum),
    median_mapping_error = median(bmm_mapping_error),
    frac_qc_fail = mean(!qc_pass),
    frac_HBB_detected = mean(rna_HBB > 0),
    median_knn_prob = median(bmm_label_prob),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

What ScPCA's consensus calls the CD235ab-negative late erythroid cells, top labels:

```{r erythroid-neg-consensus}
cells |>
  filter(bmm_label_broad == "Late Erythroid", !pos_CD235ab) |>
  count(consensus_celltype_annotation, sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  head(10) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

## Protein by label

Mean ADT value (color, scaled per target across both panels) and fraction positive (size) for
each BoneMarrowMap fine label, in the healthy controls and in AML. Cells passing QC, singlets,
labels with at least 20 such cells in a panel.

```{r adt-dot-data}
adt_long <- cells |>
  filter(qc_pass, singlet) |>
  select(role, bmm_label, starts_with("adt_"), starts_with("pos_")) |>
  select(-any_of("adt_scpca_filter")) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    -c(role, bmm_label),
    names_to = c(".value", "target"),
    names_pattern = "^(adt|pos)_(.+)$"
  )

adt_dot <- adt_long |>
  group_by(role, bmm_label, target) |>
  summarize(n_cells = n(), mean_adt = mean(adt, na.rm = TRUE), frac_pos = mean(pos, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_cells >= 20) |>
  group_by(target) |>
  mutate(scaled = (mean_adt - min(mean_adt)) / (max(mean_adt) - min(mean_adt))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    bmm_label = factor(bmm_label, levels = rev(fine_levels)),
    target = factor(target, levels = c(
      "CD90", "CD49f", "CD133", "CD45RA", "CD123", "CD366", "CD33", "CD7",
      "CD36", "CD32", "CD71", "CD235ab", "CD10", "CD19", "CD3", "CD25", "CD127", "CD152",
      "CD279", "CD274", "CD45"
    ))
  )
stopifnot(!anyNA(adt_dot$target))
```

```{r adt-dot-plot, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 16}
ggplot(adt_dot, aes(x = target, y = bmm_label, color = scaled, size = frac_pos)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~role) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = seq_blue, limits = c(0, 1), name = "Scaled mean") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 4.5, limits = c(0, 1), name = "Fraction positive") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "BoneMarrowMap label", title = "ADT by BoneMarrowMap label") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))
```

### HSPC state

Inside the HSPC compartment, the expected pattern in normal marrow is HSC/MPP CD90+ CD49f+
CD45RA−, with CD45RA gained in LMPP/MLP and GMP. Distributions per label, healthy controls vs
AML, for the HSPC targets and the LSC-associated targets (CD123, TIM-3/CD366).

```{r hspc-state, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 9}
hspc_labels <- c("HSC", "MPP-MkEry", "MPP-MyLy", "LMPP", "MLP", "MLP-II", "CLP",
                 "Cycling Progenitor", "Early GMP", "GMP-Cycle", "GMP-Neut", "GMP-Mono",
                 "MEP", "BFU-E", "EoBasoMast Precursor")

hspc_long <- adt_long |>
  filter(bmm_label %in% hspc_labels, target %in% c("CD90", "CD49f", "CD133", "CD45RA", "CD123",
                                                   "CD366")) |>
  add_count(role, bmm_label, target, name = "n_label") |>
  filter(n_label >= 20) |>
  mutate(
    bmm_label = factor(bmm_label, levels = rev(intersect(fine_levels, hspc_labels))),
    target = factor(target, levels = c("CD90", "CD49f", "CD133", "CD45RA", "CD123", "CD366"))
  )

ggplot(hspc_long, aes(x = adt, y = bmm_label, linetype = role)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "#1baf7a", fill = NA, outlier.size = 0.2, outlier.alpha = 0.2,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_vline(
    data = adt_thresholds |> filter(target %in% levels(hspc_long$target)) |>
      mutate(target = factor(target, levels = levels(hspc_long$target))),
    aes(xintercept = threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = ink_muted
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~target, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`healthy control` = "dashed", AML = "solid"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "ADT (logcounts)", y = NULL, title = "HSPC and LSC-associated protein by label",
       subtitle = "Dashed vertical line: positivity threshold")
```

```{r hspc-state-table}
adt_long |>
  filter(bmm_label %in% hspc_labels, target %in% c("CD90", "CD49f", "CD133", "CD45RA", "CD123",
                                                   "CD366")) |>
  group_by(role, bmm_label, target) |>
  summarize(n_cells = n(), frac_pos = mean(pos, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_cells >= 20) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = target, values_from = frac_pos) |>
  mutate(bmm_label = factor(bmm_label, levels = intersect(fine_levels, hspc_labels))) |>
  arrange(role, bmm_label) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

## RNA markers by label

Mean log-normalized expression (color, scaled per gene across both panels) and fraction of
cells with any expression (size), by BoneMarrowMap broad label. Cells passing QC, singlets,
labels with at least 20 such cells in a panel.

```{r rna-dot-plot, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 9}
rna_dot <- cells |>
  filter(qc_pass, singlet) |>
  select(role, bmm_label_broad, starts_with("rna_")) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(starts_with("rna_"), names_to = "gene", names_prefix = "rna_",
                      values_to = "expr") |>
  group_by(role, bmm_label_broad, gene) |>
  summarize(n_cells = n(), mean_expr = mean(expr), frac_expr = mean(expr > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_cells >= 20) |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  mutate(scaled = mean_expr / max(mean_expr)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    bmm_label_broad = factor(bmm_label_broad, levels = rev(broad_levels)),
    gene = factor(gene, levels = rna_genes)
  )

ggplot(rna_dot, aes(x = gene, y = bmm_label_broad, color = scaled, size = frac_expr)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~role, ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = seq_blue, limits = c(0, 1), name = "Scaled mean") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3.5, limits = c(0, 1), name = "Fraction expressing") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "BoneMarrowMap broad label", title = "Marker genes by BoneMarrowMap label") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 70, hjust = 1, size = 7))
```

EoBasoMast calls need basophil/mast genes (`HDC`, `CPA3`, `MS4A2`), not just tryptase
(`bonemarrowmap.md`, step 5):

```{r eobasomast}
cells |>
  filter(bmm_label_broad == "EoBasoMast Precursor") |>
  group_by(role) |>
  summarize(
    n_cells = n(),
    across(c(rna_HDC, rna_CPA3, rna_MS4A2, rna_CLC, rna_TPSAB1, rna_CD34), \(x) mean(x > 0))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

## Comparison with ScPCA's consensus labels

Rows are BoneMarrowMap broad labels, normalized to sum to 1. Columns are ScPCA's consensus
labels (the 15 most common; the rest pooled as "other"). All cells.

```{r consensus-crosstab, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 14}
top_consensus <- cells |>
  count(consensus_celltype_annotation, sort = TRUE) |>
  head(15) |>
  pull(consensus_celltype_annotation)

consensus_df <- cells |>
  transmute(
    assay = as.character(role),
    row = bmm_label_broad,
    col = if_else(consensus_celltype_annotation %in% top_consensus,
                  consensus_celltype_annotation, "other")
  )

plot_crosstab(
  consensus_df,
  title = "BoneMarrowMap broad label vs. ScPCA consensus label",
  row_title = "BoneMarrowMap broad label",
  col_title = "ScPCA consensus label",
  row_levels = broad_levels,
  col_levels = c(top_consensus, "other")
)
```

## Composition by library

Share of each library's cells in each BoneMarrowMap broad label, with the fraction failing
project-wide QC. Libraries are grouped by role, then ordered by subdiagnosis.

```{r composition, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 10}
composition <- cells |>
  count(role, library_id, subdiagnosis, bmm_label_broad) |>
  group_by(library_id) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

library_order <- cells |>
  distinct(role, library_id, subdiagnosis) |>
  arrange(role, subdiagnosis, library_id) |>
  mutate(label = paste0(library_id, " (", substr(subdiagnosis, 1, 30), ")"))

qc_by_library <- cells |>
  group_by(library_id) |>
  summarize(frac_qc_fail = mean(!qc_pass))

composition |>
  left_join(library_order |> select(library_id, label), by = "library_id") |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(library_order$label)),
    bmm_label_broad = factor(bmm_label_broad, levels = broad_levels)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bmm_label_broad, y = label, fill = share)) +
  geom_tile(color = "#fcfcfb", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(share >= 0.2, sprintf("%.2f", share), ""), color = share > 0.55),
            size = 2.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = seq_blue, limits = c(0, 1), name = "Share of library") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = ink_primary, `TRUE` = "#ffffff")) +
  labs(x = "BoneMarrowMap broad label", y = NULL, title = "Composition by library") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r qc-by-library}
cells |>
  group_by(role, library_id, subdiagnosis) |>
  summarize(
    n_cells = n(),
    median_mapping_error = median(bmm_mapping_error),
    frac_qc_fail = mean(!qc_pass),
    median_genes_detected = median(detected),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(median_mapping_error)) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

## Mapping error and transcriptional complexity

Is mapping error related to how many genes a cell expresses? Spearman correlation by broad label,
healthy controls vs AML (labels with at least 50 cells).

```{r error-vs-complexity}
cells |>
  group_by(role, bmm_label_broad) |>
  filter(n() >= 50) |>
  summarize(
    n_cells = n(),
    median_genes_detected = median(detected),
    median_mapping_error = median(bmm_mapping_error),
    spearman_error_vs_detected = cor(bmm_mapping_error, detected, method = "spearman"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(bmm_label_broad, role) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```
